A 3D cyber-cat runner: your cat runs, jumps, and auto-shoots zombies while you dodge obstacles and grab coins.

• Swipe left/right to change lane

• Power-ups: shield, 2x points, rapid fire, coin magnet

Play, score, and claim $JVC from the game contract.

1. Open the play link in a wallet browser (MetaMask, Rabby…) on Robinhood Chain testnet
2. Start: $JVC coin + a small 0.0005 ETH fee (plus network gas)
3. Play the round. Swipes are recorded and verified so scores can’t be faked
4. Hit the minimum score shown in-game — 100 points = 1 JVC
5. Tap Claim, sign, pay gas, receive JVC

**MASK by Faceless | AI × Campus Education × Web3**
We’ve launched $MASK on vibe/vibe testnet, connected to what we’re building at Faceless.

**What is Faceless?**
A campus creator and distribution network. We establish blockchain clubs, teach students face-to-face, and help them use wallets, games and partner apps through recurring sessions.

**What does Mask do?**
Mask is our AI classroom cohost. It explains concepts and retrieves animated lessons during live sessions, with a human facilitator guiding students. We’ve demonstrated blockchain, USDT and Bitcoin lessons in real classrooms. It’s an evolving product already being tested with students.

**Already operating at one college**
Our May 2026 case studies from current College, report:
• 1,500+ students onboarded
• $5,000+ in student rewards distributed
• Activations involving Bybit, Kult Games, Pudgy Penguins, Backpack, CoinDCX and Monad

**Revenue and rewards**
Brands fund campaigns around verified product actions. We run workshops, track completion and verify results; student rewards have been distributed through UPI or partner-platform credit. Campaign pricing depends on scope, cohort size and verification requirements.

**How we scale**
The next step is to package the GRD model for more colleges: local club leads, shared lessons, Mask-assisted sessions, partner campaigns and consistent verification. Our case-study document lists 30+ colleges in the pipeline; these are not live deployments.

$MASK is the testnet token associated with this project. The classroom product and campaign results above describe Faceless’s operations.
